question: What powers of distant hearing and bond-paralysis arise from this practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is named.
Paralysis of bonds is named likewise.
The beloved is addressed as recipient of this teaching.
inference: The practice yields knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the paralysis of bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean arresting or immobilizing bonds
plain_english: O beloved, there arises knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the paralysis of bonds.
